achievements.name: Nahobino
achievements.detail: Fuse with the Proto-fiend Aogami and fight on as a Nahobino.

achievements.name: Silver Tongue
achievements.detail: Recruit 30 demons by negotiating with them during battle.

achievements.name: Press Turns
achievements.detail: Strike an enemy weakness 100 times and take the extra press turns those hits grant.

achievements.name: Magatsuhi Skill
achievements.detail: Use Magatsuhi skills 20 times after the Magatsuhi gauge fills.

achievements.name: Fusion Accident
achievements.detail: Come away from demon fusion with a result you did not choose when an accident occurs.

achievements.name: Five Miracles
achievements.detail: Learn five Miracles by spending Glory.

achievements.name: Compendium Scholar
achievements.detail: Register enough demons to fill more than 75 percent of the Demon Compendium.

achievements.name: Essence Fusion
achievements.detail: Perform Essence Fusion 20 times so a demon takes on skills from an essence.

achievements.name: Haunt Gifts
achievements.detail: Give gifts to demons in a demon haunt 20 times.

achievements.name: Godborn
achievements.detail: Clear the game on Godborn difficulty.

achievements.name: Demi-fiend
achievements.detail: Defeat the Demi-fiend in the optional superboss fight.
